# Next Iteration — AI for Locals

> Practical, plain-English AI help for local small businesses and individuals on and around the Mornington Peninsula, Victoria, Australia. Provided by Gareth Reid (Next Iteration). Free, no-pressure AI review available. No hype, no hard sell.

## Who and what

- **Provider:** Gareth Reid, trading as Next Iteration.
- **What:** AI guidance, setup and training; workflow and admin automation; data, reporting and decision support; websites, marketing and content support; custom tools, documentation and knowledge systems.
- **For whom:** Small and local businesses, individuals, families and community users — including older or less technical people.
- **Where:** Mornington Peninsula, Mornington, Frankston, South East Melbourne, Western Port and nearby regions in Victoria, Australia. Service-area based (no public storefront).
- **Differentiator:** Local, practical, and plain-English, backed by serious technical experience — including work at Peter MacCallum Cancer Centre and CSL in healthcare, pathology, cancer research and biopharmaceutical software, automation and data.
- **Trust caveat:** If there is no clear way for AI, automation or better reporting to help, Gareth will say so rather than sell an unnecessary project. 

## Primary call to action

- Book a Free AI Review: https://next-iteration.com/#get-started

## Services

- AI Setup & Training — choosing, setting up and learning tools like ChatGPT and Claude, with plain-English training and safe-use guidance.
- Workflow & Admin Automation — simpler workflows for enquiries, onboarding, follow-ups, scheduling and document generation.
- Data, Reporting & Decision Support — clearer reporting from spreadsheets, booking systems and CRMs; dashboards, summaries and simple forecasting.
- Websites, Marketing & Content Support — clearer website copy, listings, emails, FAQs and posts that sound human, not generic.
- Custom Tools, Documentation & Knowledge Systems — SOPs, how-to guides, checklists and searchable knowledge bases.
